newsitem.title: USA: Mellon Q3 profit up, interest revenue down.
newsitem.headline: Mellon Q3 profit up, interest revenue down.

text.p: Mellon Bank Corp said earnings per share increased 16 percent in the third quarter of 1996 on an annualized basis ccompared with the second quarter of 1996.
The rise to $1.31 per share in the September quarter resulted from an annualized increase of 12 percent in growth of continuing business and four percent from fewer shares.
Net income applicable to common stock was $172 million in the third quarter, up 3.6 percent from a year ago.
Net interest revenue in the third quarter was $372 million, down five percent from $392 million a year ago.
The lower net interest revenue from a year ago reflected credit card and home equity securitizations and the repurchase of common shares, Mellon said.
Fee revenue in the third quarter was $476 million, up 13 percent from $422 million a year ago.

Nonperforming assets totaled $209 million at the end of the third quarter, compared to $209 million at the end of the second quarter and $261 million a year ago. The nonperforming assets ratio was 0.74 percent at the of the third quarter versus 0.74 percent at the end of the second quarter and 0.93 percent a year ago.
